# BoyLove (香香腐宅) fixtures

`series.html` and `reader.html` contain public fields from [猎人只想安静生活【台版】](https://boylove.cc/home/book/index/id/32391) and its [first chapter](https://boylove.cc/home/book/capter/id/2671926), captured on 2026-10-25. They preserve 68 catalog entries, VIP flags, and the 35-page reader with its image URLs, dimensions, and reconstruction data.

`series-shagua-tiandi.html` and `reader-shagua-tiandi.html` contain a second capture from [傻瓜天地](https://boylove.cc/home/book/index/id/34260), taken on the same date: nine chapters and the 88-page reader for chapter `2699104`. The two-page inputs in `contract.json` are synthetic error and resource-lifetime cases.

The HTML is stripped of account state and unrelated page content. Browser tests use generated PNG images at the declared dimensions; no chapter artwork is stored.
